errors.what: Wrong assembly branch: at t=0 the coupler/rocker joint B is below the X axis (rocker panel 297.3 deg) whereas the spec requires B above the X axis (y>0, rocker about 62.7 deg). The whole cycle is the mirror-image configuration (B below the ground line, rocker angles in the 230-305 deg range instead of the expected upper-half values).
